title: Sempra 8-K Filing — 2026-04-17
summary: Sempra subsidiary Oncor Electric Delivery Company LLC received a final order from the Public Utility Commission of Texas (PUCT) on April 17, 2026, approving a comprehensive base rate review settlement with an annual revenue requirement of approximately $6.97 billion, representing an increase of $560 million (8.7%) over prior adjusted annualized revenues. The order increases the authorized return on equity to 9.75% and the authorized cost of debt to 4.94%, while improving the regulatory capital structure to 56.5% debt / 43.5% equity.
key_points: PUCT approved final order on April 17, 2026 in docket number 58306 for Oncor's comprehensive base rate review
Annual revenue requirement set at approximately $6.97 billion, an increase of $560 million (8.7%)
Authorized return on equity increased to 9.75% from 9.70%
Authorized cost of debt increased to 4.94% from 4.39%
Regulatory capital structure improved to 56.5% debt / 43.5% equity from 57.5% debt / 42.5% equity
Self-insurance reserve annual accrual increased to $200 million from $122 million
Oncor expects positive impacts to future earnings, cash flow, and credit metrics
